request.query: For linearly independent polynomials of equal degree cancel leading coefficients and decrease sum of degrees

items.name: Polynomial.cancelLeads
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : Ring R] → Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R

items.name: MonomialOrder.degree_prod_of_regular
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {m : MonomialOrder σ} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} {P : ι → MvPolynomial σ R}
  {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, IsRegular (m.leadingCoeff (P i))) → m.degree (∏ i ∈ s, P i) = ∑ i ∈ s, m.degree (P i)

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_cancelLeads_lt_of_natDegree_le_natDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree → 0 < q.natDegree → (p.cancelLeads q).natDegree < q.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_cancelLeads_lt_of_natDegree_le_natDegree_of_comm
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  p.leadingCoeff * q.leadingCoeff = q.leadingCoeff * p.leadingCoeff →
    p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree → 0 < q.natDegree → (p.cancelLeads q).natDegree < q.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_prod'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : ι → Polynomial R),
  ∏ i ∈ s, (f i).leadingCoeff ≠ 0 → (∏ i ∈ s, f i).natDegree = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree
